sources.title: Anthropic raises Series E at $61.5B post-money valuation

event.title: Anthropic Series E
event.summary: Anthropic raised a $3.5 billion Series E round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation.

participants.note: Named as Fidelity Management & Research Company

amounts.label: Series E equity
amounts.quote: Anthropic has raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation.

amounts.label: Post-money valuation
amounts.quote: Anthropic has raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation.

facts.label: Other named investors
facts.text: Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco Investments, D1 Capital Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo Ventures and Salesforce Ventures, among other new and existing investors.
facts.quote: The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco Investments, D1 Capital Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo Ventures and Salesforce Ventures, among other new and existing investors.
